en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, and Ali Bin Muhammad, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Jameel Bin Salih, from Al Fuzayl Bin Yasaar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘I am standing in the Salāt, so I see the faeces in front of me towards the Qiblah. So heasws said: ‘Isolate from it whatever you can, and do not pray Salāt upon the centre of the road’.
en.sarwar: 17. Muhammad ibn al-Hassan and Ali ibn Muhammad have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Ri’ab from Jamil ibn Salih, from Fudayl ibn Yasar who has said the following:

“I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘I stand up for Salah (prayer) and see feces in the direction of al-Qiblah (al-Ka‘bah). He (the Imam) said, ‘Keep away from it as much as you can and do not perform Salah (prayer) on a main road.’”
